name: agentarmy-hmac-verify
description: HMAC-signature verification sidecar — extracts a reusable function-tier pattern out of templates/event-bridge-image/ where it lives today. Sits as an ingress sidecar in front of any spoke that accepts signed webhooks (GitHub, Stripe, Postmark, custom). Verifies `X-*-Signature*` constant-time using a shared secret resolved from Azure Key Vault, then forwards the verified request to the spoke. Scaffolded as part of the contract-backlog PR; real implementation lifts the constant-time verifier from event-bridge.

shims.note: stdlib hmac.compare_digest is the load-bearing primitive (constant-time, secure-by-default). cryptography pulled for KV-resolved secrets only. Mirrors the security posture of event-bridge.

baked.purpose: PLANNED — FastAPI app that verifies HMAC headers per provider config (github | stripe | postmark | custom), then proxies the verified request to UPSTREAM_URL.
PLANNED — POST with wrong sig -> 401; POST with right sig -> 200 + upstream reached; replay-detector test (same delivery-id twice -> second is 409).

doctor.description: PLANNED — /healthz 200; bad sig -> 401; good sig -> 200 + forwarded to upstream; replay of same delivery-id within TTL -> 409.

deploy.notes: Deployed as a sidecar in front of any spoke that accepts signed webhooks. The webhook-receiver spec (contracts/webhook-receiver.openapi.yaml) is the GitHub-specific consumer; this image generalizes.

contract.note: No new contract — this image realizes the verification half of the webhook-receiver contract for any signed-webhook source.
